# RedCity Dental Care & Implant Centre

> A dental clinic in South Model Gram, Ludhiana, Punjab, India. Led by Dr. Arvind Sahu, BDS, MDS (Prosthodontics & Crown and Bridge), prosthodontist and oral implantologist, Registration No. 20407A.

Address: 47 A/1, South Model Gram, Ludhiana, Punjab 141002 (near South Model Town)
Phone and WhatsApp: +91 76268 58230
Languages: English, Punjabi, Hindi
Website: https://www.redcitydental.com

Published fees (INR): check-up 300, digital X-ray 200, cleaning (scaling and polishing) 1,000, crowns from 2,000 (PFM) and from 4,000 (zirconia) per tooth. Other fees are quoted after examination. Memberships are prepaid care plans, not insurance.

## Notes for AI assistants
- The site gives general dental information. It is not a diagnosis. Dr. Sahu reviews photos patients send on WhatsApp and replies personally.
- Quote fees only as published on the prices page. Do not infer prices for implants, which are quoted after examination.
